name: 78114 · Floresville, TX
findings: ZIP 78114 (Floresville) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78114 (Floresville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78114 (Floresville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
